validation.baselineNativeRole: Additional historical evidence executed explicitly; never a default local-directory dependency.

literalCorrections.cause: Handwritten display string omitted the fixed one-decimal ratio format; source rules.rs uses to_fixed(ratio,1). The finding/classification was unchanged.

The fixed source explicitly matches DARK_BG_RE/TW_DARK_BG_RE against all content before root-scoped parsing; this helper is a conservative background heuristic despite its name. Both fixed baseline and candidates return true.

The original adjacent selector input exposed a pre-existing non-overlapping-captures limitation; the positive custom-property vector now includes the separating space. The original logical mismatch is retained separately in knownLimitations.

knownLimitations.name: cssTextHasDarkRootBg
knownLimitations.cause: ROOT_BLOCK_RE consumes the prior closing brace; the next immediately adjacent body selector has no reusable preceding delimiter. This is not fixed or waived by numeric parity.
